decisions.reason: The firm's prior investment and public commitment to this automation product, and the continued possibility of attributing weak results to temporary factors, lead management to persist with it.
Because the web tool fits the announced digital networking direction and the firm has publicly committed to it, escalation of commitment favors keeping it.
As a recently launched product close to the established water-control offer, early weak results can still be seen as temporary, so the firm keeps it.
The energy management system aligns with the firm's stated direction toward energy recovery and digital control, so management remains committed and keeps it.
The product line's own page and close relation to the established offer signal visible commitment, so escalation of commitment leads the firm to keep the overflow flap gate.
